summary: Live clock where each changing digit rolls to the next and sheds a few pixels; switching time zone rolls every digit at once.

keyboard.action: In the time-zone switch: select and focus the previous or next zone, wrapping at the ends.

accessibility: The time-zone switch is a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Time zone"`; each option has `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`. Only the checked option is in the tab order; arrow keys move the selection.

The time is text in a `role="timer"` element with `aria-live="off"`. Assistive technology reads one visually hidden line with the time and zone, for example "14:05:09, UTC"; the rolling digits are `aria-hidden`.
The 12-hour toggle is a native button with `aria-pressed`. The date line is plain text.
motion: With reduced motion, digits change in place without rolling or shedding pixels; the colon still pulses each second.
notes: The zones are fixed: Local, UTC, Tokyo and New York, formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. In 12-hour mode, AM or PM is appended to the date line.
The digits are set in the monospace font, from 26 to 52px depending on the width. The pixel layer behind them draws only while pixels fly; between seconds the element sleeps.
